config.description: REF token (the code of token.v2.ref-finance.near, code hash HagtKcVn...). `new(owner, total_supply)` mints the whole supply to the owner; note the argument is `owner`, not `owner_id`.

setup.funder_from: largest holder among the user accounts

P1.supply_eq_sum.statement: after every block ft_total_supply equals the sum of ft_balance_of over the watched accounts

P1.exact_transfer.statement: a successful ft_transfer of an amount lowers the sender by exactly that amount, raises the receiver by exactly that amount and changes nobody else and not the supply; a failed one changes nothing

P2.settlement_completed.statement: an accepted ft_transfer_call is settled: the token's own settlement callback runs, succeeds and returns the used amount

P2.refund_le_amount.statement: the used amount the token reports and the tokens that move back to the sender do not exceed the transferred amount

P2.reported_refund_eq_returned.statement: the refund the token reports (the amount minus the used amount its settlement returns) equals the tokens that actually moved back to the sender

P2.receiver_keeps_used.statement: the receiver ends with exactly the amount minus the reported refund (minus what it paid out itself)

P2.pair_conserved.statement: a settled ft_transfer_call changes only the sender and the receiver (and the accounts the receiver paid itself); the changes sum to zero and the supply does not change

P2.refund_follows_reply.statement: the refund is what the receiver's reply asks for: min(unused, amount) when it returns a number, the whole amount when it fails

P2.rejected_call_no_effect.statement: a rejected ft_transfer_call changes no balance and not the supply

P3.foreign_resolve_fails.statement: the settlement callback run by anyone but the token's own pending transfer (a user, a contract, another contract's callback, a transaction signed with the token's key) fails

P3.foreign_resolve_no_effect.statement: an attempt of a stranger to run the settlement callback changes no balance and not the supply

P4.lowered_only_by_holder.statement: a balance falls in a round only if its holder made a successful call to the token in that round

P4.non_transfer_op_changes_others.statement: storage_deposit, storage_withdraw, a view sent as a transaction, a repeated init and NEAR sent to the token change no balance; storage_unregister changes none but the caller's

P5.unregister_refused.statement: storage_unregister without force=true by an account with a positive balance changes no balance and not the supply

not_checked: NEAR-side storage accounting of NEP-145: the deposits the token keeps, the refunds it pays, the storage minimum, and that the token stays able to pay its refunds (property P5, except the balance side of storage_unregister)
gas: the gas the token gives to ft_on_transfer and to its settlement callback, and behaviour at gas limits
events (NEP-297 logs), error texts and the contents of ft_metadata
the deployed contract: its state, access keys, owner rights and upgrade path; the run is about the code initialized with the config's arguments in a simulator
inputs outside the 1000 random traces of this run: the verdict is agreement on these traces, not a proof for all inputs
